items.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
items.description: The cyber-attack last month saw fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets across France heated up.

items.title: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say
items.description: Six people were killed in the shooting, and three bodies of the suspect's family members were found at their home.

items.title: Inside the French drug gangs recruiting children to kill
items.description: The BBC enters Marseille's dangerous underworld, where young people are trapped, brutalised and exploited.

items.title: Cruise ship pianist rescued from sea after nine hours in Pacific Ocean
items.description: Two US fishermen say they spotted the man treading water around 20 miles (32km) off the Californian coast.

items.title: Trump questions midterm elections integrity after previously accepting results
items.description: Trump made the claims, without evidence, on Truth Social on Monday.

items.title: Nine Zimbabweans caught allegedly trying to leave South Africa to fight in Ukraine
items.description: Hundreds of people from different African countries have been recruited to fight for Russia, according to Ukraine.

items.title: At least 39 die after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal
items.description: The Atlantic crossing to Spain's Canary Islands remains dangerous for migrants seeking a better life

items.title: Thirteen migrants die after boat sinks off Crete
items.description: The Greek coastguard says it has rescued 18 people, all of whom were Sudanese nationals.

items.title: Pope delivers veiled rebuke of Milei's austerity measures
items.description: Pope Leo made the comments as he arrived in Argentina on the second leg of his Latin America tour.

items.title: Four killed in Gaza after sand embankment collapses onto tents, health ministry says
items.description: Three children are among those killed in the incident that came a day after heavy rain reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents across Gaza.

items.title: Trump says he was 'kidding' about Dana White press secretary offer
items.description: The president told the Ultimate Fighting Championship boss to "please take the job" in a Truth Social post on Saturday.

items.title: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt
items.description: Several carriages derailed after two trains travelling in the same direction crashed outside the city of Giza.
